import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    am = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    skobki = "_"
    start = 0

    while start < len(s):
        last_open = -1
        processed = False

        i = start
        while i < len(s):
            c = s[i]
            if c == '(':
                last_open = i
            if c == ')':
                skobki = skobki + s[last_open + 1:i] + "_"
                s = s[:last_open] + "_" + s[i + 1:]
                start = last_open
                processed = True
                break
            i += 1

        if not processed:
            break

    arr = skobki.split("_")
    count = 0
    for part in arr:
        if part != "":
            count += 1

    arr = s.split("_")
    max_len = 0
    for part in arr:
        if len(part) > max_len:
            max_len = len(part)

    print(f"{max_len} {count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
